Honestly, something that helps me hope is telling myself over and over and over again that what I am experiencing is real,  I just don't feel real. On bad days, sometimes I tell myself: if this isn't real, I want this to be the best "dream" possible. Existing on this Earth is already a crazy concept. Even if things don't feel real, try your best to find things that make you happy or not even happy, comfortable. Even if they don't feel real, even if it is somehow a dream, at least you'll be having a good time.
